name: The Explorer
flavorTemplates: You have visited {biomes} biomes, have {bases} unfinished bases, and somehow your bed is always {distance} blocks away.
You've walked {distance} blocks from home and called it 'just checking something out.' {biomes} biomes and counting.

name: The Builder
flavorTemplates: You've placed roughly {blocks} blocks with intention, redesigned your base {redesigns} times, and still aren't satisfied.
Symmetry is a personality trait. {blocks} blocks placed, {redesigns} full redesigns, zero regrets.

name: The Miner
flavorTemplates: You've mined {ores} ore blocks, dug {caves} cave systems, and your pickaxe has seen things.
{ores} ores mined, {caves} caves explored. Sunlight is a concept you vaguely remember.

name: The Redstone Engineer
flavorTemplates: You've built {contraptions} contraptions, debugged {bugs} wiring disasters, and explained circuits to nobody who asked.
{contraptions} machines built. {bugs} of them technically still on fire.

name: Agent of Chaos
flavorTemplates: You've triggered {explosions} unplanned explosions, lost {items} items to lava, and somehow this is a lifestyle.
{explosions} explosions you definitely meant to cause, {items} inventory slots' worth of regret.
